Class ElectricVehicle

java.lang.Object
ElectricVehicle
public class ElectricVehicle extends Object
Represents an electric vehicle with battery capacity, charge state, and efficiency metrics. The vehicle's range is calculated based on current efficiency, state of charge, and battery capacity.

  • Constructor Details

    • ElectricVehicle

      public ElectricVehicle(String name, double batteryCapacity, double stateOfCharge, double defaultEfficiency)
      Constructs an ElectricVehicle with the specified parameters. Values are clamped to valid ranges as follows: - Battery capacity: 10.0 to 150.0 kWh - State of charge: 0.15 to 1.0 (15% to 100%) - Default efficiency: 0.5 to 4.5 - Name: set to "Unknown EV" if null or empty
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the vehicle
      batteryCapacity - the battery capacity in kWh
      stateOfCharge - the state of charge as a decimal (0.15 to 1.0)
      defaultEfficiency - the default efficiency rating

  • Method Details

    • range

      public double range()
      Calculates and returns the current range of the vehicle in miles. Range is calculated as: current efficiency × state of charge × battery capacity
      Returns:
      the range in miles

    • updateEfficiency

      public void updateEfficiency(double currentTemp)
      Updates the current efficiency based on the current temperature in Fahrenheit. Rules: - If 65°F ≤ temp ≤ 77°F: efficiency is 100% of default - If temp > 77°F: efficiency is 85% of default - If temp invalid input: '<' 65°F: efficiency decreases 1% per degree below 65°F, minimum 50% of default
      Parameters:
      currentTemp - the current temperature in Fahrenheit
